summary: A student who transfers is added to the class where they end up and taken out of the one they left.
realLife: States add students who transfer in and subtract those who transfer out when they work out a class's graduation rate.
sources: NCES, Fast Facts: High school graduation rates: https://nces.ed.gov/fastfacts/display.asp?id=805
inGame: the people module's life records, read by lifeOf in src/bench/loading.ts: a move/moved-in before school/finished puts the diploma at the new place.
